$comment: STEP 40 held-out language-quality and persistent-policy dataset (120 cases: 40 Thai, 40 English, 20 mixed-language/technical, 20 persistent policy / conflicting instructions / no-match). Written for Step 40, after the skills were authored, and not used to tune them; the 154 Step 37-38 case specifications remain the skills' development set. Synthetic material only: no customer text, real credentials or personal data. The runner sends `request`, a blank line, then `input` (when present) as one user message in a fresh session. `arms`: A = agent without the plugin, B = plugin only, C = plugin plus the opt-in host policy. Automated checks are scored by tools/evals/score-step40.mjs; `checks` are human-observable assertions and `rubric` names the human-scored dimensions (docs/chayen/HUMANIZER_EVALUATION_RUBRIC.md). No result exists until an authorized run produces outputs.
